description: Morning Anxiety Relief | Sarangi Raga Bhairavi | 1.5 Hours — soft dawn strings to settle an anxious morning.

Ninety minutes of slow sarangi in Raga Bhairavi, the raga of dawn, over a warm tanpura drone. The sarangi is the closest instrument to the human voice — steady, warm, and reassuring when the day starts with a racing heart.
🎧 HOW TO USE — play low from waking, through your morning routine. Loops seamlessly.
⏱ BEST FOR — morning anxiety · waking up worried · a racing heart at dawn · calm starts
🎵 ABOUT — Raga Bhairavi at dawn settles the breath; on sarangi its phrases feel like being spoken to gently.
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, slow expressive sarangi in Raga Bhairavi over a warm tanpura drone, gentle dawn phrases, vocal-like sustained bowing, no percussion, ~55 BPM, soothing morning anxiety relief, seamless loop.
suno_prompt_note: Sarangi = no tabla. Dawn Bhairavi, warm and reassuring, NOT mournful (avoid the Nostalgia grief register). Format B compact.
